creativity.reason: Level 0: the business is hearing aids, diagnostics and hearing clinics, with no creative activity ('state-of-the-art' and product design are traps).

community.reason: Level 2: specific external clinical training and local clinic outreach with no reach figures, plus employee development programmes.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 4: customer access for people with a disability (hearing loss) is a major part of the business, with measured reach (12.1 million lives, 1.6 million tested); chose 4 over 5 because the rubric says to pick the lower level when torn.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: based only on general description; the company sells to hearing care professionals and largely independent clinics but offers no specific enabling programme for them.

internal_findings.quote: In 2025, Demant received 38 reports through its whistleblower hotline concerning discrimination and/or harassment.
internal_findings.section: Annual report > Social > S1 Own workforce > Equal treatment and opportunities for all > S1-17
internal_findings.explanation: These are internal whistleblower reports (32 of 38 handled); the text does not say how many were substantiated. It reports no fines, penalties, compensation or confirmed severe human rights incidents and no outside finding. Noted for the team only; costs no points.

internal_note: Discloses internally substantiated discrimination and/or harassment cases; not a red flag under the rule.

evidence.activity: Core business sells hearing aids (assistive technology) and runs clinics that test and fit people with hearing loss, a disability, so they can communicate and take part in daily life

evidence.section: Annual report > Overview > CEO letter > Lives improved
evidence.indicators: 1.6 million people were tested; 12.1 million lives

notes: Cross-cultural score of 4 depends on treating hearing aids and clinic services as disability access (assistive technology helping people with hearing loss 'connect and communicate with the world around them'); flag for human check on consistency with other Health Care companies. Revised Diversity and Inclusion Policy applies only from Q1 2026 (planned, not scored). Global Policy on Remuneration and Rewards was postponed to 2026. KIND (acquired Dec 2025, about 3,000 employees) is not covered by 2025 policies or actions. Oticon Medical and EPOS are being divested. Distributor support ('maturing their business') is channel development for its own sales, not an entrepreneurship enabling programme. Inclusion score (4.30) and gender metrics are disclosures only. No tobacco, coal or weapons involvement; these are reported as not material.
